newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends mixed in featureless trade.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends mixed in featureless trade.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were quoted mixed at the close in featureless trade, dealers said.
"Most (players) are still on leave...we might see some action on Monday," a trader said as he wrapped up for the week.
Dealers said the extension of the Chinese Lunar New Year and Moslem Eid al-Fitr festive holidays from last week had left a lull in the market through the whole of this week.

At the close, March RSS1 buyer was quoted at 304 cents by the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board (MRELB), down 1.50 cents ($) a kg unchanged from Thursday. February SMR20 was unchanged at 300 cents.
The INRO five-day average was 233.96 Malaysian/Singapore cents per kg on Feb 13 from 232.26 on Feb 12. The daily indicator was at 235.57 against 235.61.
